technique_name: Propose a strategy to improve the public education system.
description: One strategy to improve the public education system is to prioritize professional development for educators. Investing in the education and training of teachers is essential in order to ensure that students have access to quality instruction. Professional development can take many forms, and should be tailored to the specific needs of the educators, students, and schools.
